summary: Maps a character code (a1) to an event ID. Special codes 9875 and 9876 map based on the variant selector a4 (397/426 to 45/46; 1/2 to 42/43). Otherwise the code is indexed into a lookup table selected by a2 (0 selects unk_5BEE08, 1 selects unk_5BF4C0). On a successful mapping it copies a path string into byte_5EA438 via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, writes (a1, mapped id) to the output buffer at a3+8/a3+12 and returns 0; returns 1 when the code/variant is unmapped or out of range.

local_names.a3: output buffer receiving (a1, mapped id) at +8/+12
local_names.a4: variant selector for the special codes 9875/9876

operations.description: For the special code a1 == 9875 the variant a4 must be 397 or 426; for a1 == 9876 it must be 1 or 2. Any other a1/a4 combination returns 1 immediately without writing output.
Special-case mapping: 9875 maps a4==397 to 45 and a4==426 to 46; 9876 maps a4==1 to 42 and a4==2 to 43.
Selects the lookup table by a2: unk_5BEE08 when a2==0, unk_5BF4C0 when a2==1; any other a2 leaves v4 at its default -1 and falls through to the range check.
Indexes the selected character-to-event lookup table: v4 = table[a1].
Success requires a1 >= 0 and the mapped value v4 >= 0; otherwise the function returns 1 (unmapped).
On a successful mapping, copies a path string via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc into the buffer at byte_5EA438.
Writes the character code a1 to the output buffer at a3+8 and the mapped event ID v4 at a3+12, then returns 0.
Invoked by FontRenderingPrep (00411840) while preparing font rendering state.
